summary: Reproduced the Transformers 5.12.1 deprecation from the actual Dots3Config torch_dtype getter, changed the DOTS-3 MoE dispatcher argument to config.dtype, and added a failing-before/passing-after regression covering default, float16, bfloat16, and float32 propagation through Dots3MoE and the real MaybeTboDeepEPDispatcher wrapper.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b0083b3f376f/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' (construct Dots3Config for default, float16, bfloat16, and float32; read torch_dtype and dtype) PY
tests.what_was_measured: Pinned Transformers 5.12.1 emitted '[transformers] `torch_dtype` is deprecated! Use `dtype` instead!' and both attributes returned identical values for all four cases. Raw output: reports/j-b0083b3f376f/raw/config_access.txt

All four cases reached the dispatcher with the expected dtype but failed because Dots3MoE called Transformers logger.warning_once for the deprecated torch_dtype getter. Raw output: reports/j-b0083b3f376f/raw/pytest_before.txt

Four cases passed. The actual Dots3MoE constructor and MaybeTboDeepEPDispatcher wrapper propagated None, float16, bfloat16, and float32 unchanged to a captured DeepEPDispatcher boundary without invoking the deprecated getter. Raw output: reports/j-b0083b3f376f/raw/pytest_after.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution was needed for this configuration-property compatibility fix. Heavyweight expert/kernel objects and the DeepEP transport boundary were replaced while exercising the actual Dots3MoE constructor and MaybeTboDeepEPDispatcher wrapper.

remaining_limitations: No DOTS-3 model weights were available, so full model initialization and distributed DeepEP transport were not executed.
The reported future removal of torch_dtype was not tested because the frozen environment uses Transformers 5.12.1; only its current deprecation behavior was measured.

The focused test verifies dtype propagation into the real dispatcher wrapper, with the final heavyweight DeepEPDispatcher implementation replaced by a capture module to avoid requiring a distributed runtime.
